errors.description: flow_key_q is a multi-bit value produced in parser_clk and sampled directly in lookup_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
flow_hit_pulse_q is a one-cycle parser_clk pulse consumed directly in lookup_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
flow_hit_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample lookup_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in lookup_event_o.
lookup_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector lookup_mode_q before decoding in lookup_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
parser_rst_n is used as data inside lookup_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
mgmt_snapshot_q combines parser_clk payload state with lookup_clk status state in mgmt_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
